name: Freshdesk
description: Freshdesk (by Freshworks) is an AI-powered customer service solution designed to be easy to set up and boost agent productivity while delivering seamless customer experiences.
best_for: Positioned for organizations from mid-market to enterprise, trusted by 74,000+ companies including Forbes, Bridgestone, and PepsiCo.
features: AI agents that resolve customer intent and take action
AI Copilot prioritizing agent work and recommending next steps
Unified workspace combining customer history with AI assistance
AI-powered insights identifying trends and root causes
Integrations with Slack, Teams, Shopify, Salesforce, Jira, HubSpot

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.notes: Per agent/month, billed annually (20% cheaper than monthly). Freddy AI Agent (first 500 sessions included), ticketing and shared inbox.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: Per agent/month, billed annually. Most popular. More AI and helpdesk features, multilingual helpdesk.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Per agent/month, billed annually. All AI and helpdesk features.

cons: New signups get a 14-day trial of the Enterprise plan, not the plan you'll actually pay for -- confirm your real plan's feature set before committing.
Freddy AI Copilot is a paid add-on ($29/agent/month) on top of any tier, not bundled into the base per-agent price.

alternatives.name: Zendesk
alternatives.description: An AI-first service platform unifying ticketing, omnichannel messaging, and self-learning AI agents.
alternatives.best_for: Larger organizations needing contact-center and workforce-management capability alongside AI ticketing.

alternatives.name: Gorgias
alternatives.description: A conversational AI helpdesk built specifically for ecommerce brands, especially Shopify merchants.
alternatives.best_for: Ecommerce/DTC brands wanting support tightly integrated with order and revenue data.

alternatives.name: Zoho Desk
alternatives.description: An AI-powered customer service platform that unifies support conversations across channels into one inbox, with a Zia AI assistant that handles routine tickets autonomously.
alternatives.best_for: Customer-first businesses wanting unified multichannel ticketing with AI automation
